assets.rightsBasis: Official DSCET crest served from the college's own domain (dscet.ac.in) and used on its site. No open licence; used only to identify the institution. Checked 2026-10-23: HTTP 200, image/png, 273,706 bytes, 523x477 px, black line art on a transparent background. Rendered on white and visually confirmed legible: a ring reading 'Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering & Technology' and 'Chennai' around a quartered shield (torch, folded hands, lotus, open book) above a ribbon reading 'Learning for Excellence'. Although the file is named favicon1.png, it is a full-size crest (523x477), not a 16/32 px favicon. Alternative wide colour lock-up (crest plus 'DHANALAKSHMI SRINIVASAN COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (An Autonomous Institution) ECR, MAMALLAPURAM, CHENNAI') at https://dscet.ac.in/assets/images/logo.png (471x100 px, transparent, legible on white) was not chosen because it is only 100 px tall and does not suit square tiles.

Official institutional photograph used as the homepage banner on the college's own domain (dscet.ac.in). No open licence; used only to depict the institution. Checked 2026-10-23: HTTP 200, image/jpeg, 228,506 bytes, 1920x800 px (landscape). Visually confirmed as a single real elevated photograph, not a composite or AI image: the arched entrance gate reading 'Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan College of Engineering and Technology', a basketball court, the glass-fronted four-storey main block with the college name board, further blocks and hostels behind, and a row of yellow college buses; no text overlay or watermark; no identifiable people. assets.rightsBasis: Official SASTRA logo served from the university's own admissions portal (webstream.sastra.edu) as the banner of the Applicant Registration 2026 page. Rendered on white and visually confirmed legible: the blue SASTRA crest ('Progress through quality education', 'Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy'), the wordmark 'SASTRA', the strap 'Engineering - Management - Law - Sciences - Humanities - Education', 'Deemed to be University (U/S 3 of the UGC Act, 1956)', a '40 years' anniversary badge, and 'Thanjavur | Kumbakonam | Chennai'. Wide lock-up; for square tiles crop to the crest at the left. The site header logo /templates/santosh/images/sastratransp.png (300x85) was not chosen because it is smaller.

Official institutional photograph used on the 'About SASTRA' page of the university's own domain (sastra.edu). No open licence; used only to depict the institution. Checked 2026-10-23: HTTP 200, image/jpeg, 120,163 bytes, 1600x720 px (landscape). Visually confirmed as a single real photograph, not a composite or AI image: a lawn in front of a long cream multi-storey building with a central curved, glass-fronted block in brick red, and the Indian national flag on a tall mast under an overcast sky; no text overlay or watermark; no identifiable people. Rejected: slideshow2026/02.jpeg and 05.jpeg (promotional composites with text and identifiable students), hostel/vb1-1.jpg (hostel block with caption text 'Vinaya hostel (block 1)' burnt into the image; possible student-life accommodation image only).
assets.altText: Multi-storey academic building with a curved glass-fronted central block and the Indian flag at Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy (SASTRA)
